name: Hunza
tagline: The Shangri-La of the Karakoram - Forts, Glaciers & Turquoise Lakes
description: Famed for its awe-inspiring views of Mount Rakaposhi, pristine apricot orchards, ancient heritage forts, and the dramatic Passu Cones standing along the legendary Karakoram Highway.

name: Skardu & Baltistan
tagline: World's Highest Cold Deserts, Glamping Pods & Alpine Lakes
description: Gateway to the mighty 8,000m peaks of K2 and Broad Peak. Marvel at towering sand dunes framed by snow-clad peaks, historic royal palaces, and emerald glacial waters.

name: Swat & Kalam
tagline: Switzerland of the East - Alpine Pine Forests & Crystal Rivers
description: A lush haven of rushing mountain streams, dense cedar and pine woods, thrilling chairlifts at Malam Jabba, and the stunning glacial waters of Mohadand Lake.

name: Naran, Kaghan & Babusar
tagline: High Mountain Passes & Fairy-Tale Alpine Lakes
description: Experience Pakistan's most loved summer mountain corridor. Witness the mythical Lake Saif-ul-Malook, serene Lulusar Lake, and summit the cold heights of Babusar Top.

name: Azad Kashmir & Neelum
tagline: Heaven on Earth - Emerald Forests, River LOC & Arang Kel
description: Draped in thick conifer forests and framed by roaring mountain rivers, Neelum Valley features fairy-tale wooden hamlets like Arang Kel and pristine untamed villages like Taobut.

name: Kumrat & Katora Lake
tagline: The Hidden Gem - Dense Deodar Canopies, Rushing Rivers & Glacial Basins
description: Unspoiled northern wilderness featuring colossal deodar cedar forests, crystal cold streams of Panjkora River, and high alpine treks up to Katora Lake.

name: Shogran & Siri Paye
tagline: Plateau in the Clouds - Pine Meadows & Makra Peak Vistas
description: Perched on a high alpine plateau above Kaghan Valley, Shogran offers panoramic vistas of Makra Peak, rolling horse-riding pastures at Paye, and classic 4x4 trails.
bestSeason: May – Nov (Snow stays until late spring)
